_about: IPC standard numeric tables as pure data — the machine-readable twin of IPC_STANDARDS.md (repo root). Consumed by set_design_rules / a future .kicad_dru emitter to enforce the ELECTRICAL minimums IPC defines (clearance by voltage, width by current, annular/plating by acceptance class) on top of the fab DFM floors in fab_profiles.json. The governing rule for every parameter is final = max(IPC_electrical_here, fab_DFM_floor, class_floor) — honour whichever is most conservative. Add/repoint values here with no Python change.
_units: all distances mm unless a key says otherwise. Voltage in volts (DC or AC peak between conductors). Current in amperes. Copper thickness in micrometres (um). 1 mil = 0.0254 mm.
_provenance: Researched online 2026-06-30 (multi-agent verify harness). Verification pass was truncated by an API session limit: IPC-4761 via types and copper-weight defs are 3-vote confirmed; clearance/width/class tables are 3+-source corroborated AND match the 2026-06-26-verified PCB_RULES.md R1/R2 — high-confidence DRAFT. Items flagged _uncertain need re-verify before high-voltage tape-out.
_sources: IPC-2221B Table 6-1 (magma.ca PDF, smpspowersupply.com, protoexpress); IPC-2152 (smps.us, pcbsync); IPC-7351B (pcbsync, pcblibraries); IPC-6012/A-610 (protoexpress, altium, raypcb); IPC-4761 (eurocircuits primary PDF); copper weight (jlcpcb primary).

acceptance_classes._comment: IPC-A-610 / IPC-6012 acceptance classes. class_floor values are applied as max() against fab_profiles minimums. annular_ring_external/internal in mm; plating_min_um is average hole-wall copper. conductor_width_reduction_pct is the max allowed narrowing of a fabricated conductor vs the designed width.

1.name: General electronic products
1._notes: Annular ring effectively tangency/breakout-defined; limited-life products.

2.name: Dedicated service electronic products
2._notes: DEFAULT. External ring 0.05 mm with up to 90 deg breakout permitted; internal breakout allowed.

3.name: High-performance / harsh environment
3._notes: Medical/aero/auto-safety. No external breakout. Some fabs demand 0.075 mm external ring — upgrade if required.

clearance_by_voltage._comment: IPC-2221B Table 6-1. Pick the row whose max_v >= the peak voltage between the two nets, read the column for the board condition. Default condition for Envil 2-layer boards = external_uncoated. Emit as a .kicad_dru conditional clearance rule keyed on net voltage (KiCad's flat Constraints page cannot express voltage-dependent clearance).

above_500v_per_volt_mm._comment: For peak V > 500: clearance = (value at 500 V) + adder * (V - 500). Adders reconcile to the 1000 V column from smpspowersupply.
above_500v_per_volt_mm._uncertain: protoexpress quoted internal=0.025 (10x); we use the self-consistent 0.0025. Re-verify before >500 V tape-out.

width_by_current._comment: IPC-2152 practical trace width vs current, 1 oz (35 um) EXTERNAL copper, ~10-20 degC rise. Pick the row whose max_a >= the net's current. For internal copper IPC-2152 shows nearly the same width (the old 50% derate is obsolete). For 2 oz copper a same-width trace carries ~1.5x; or scale width down ~0.6x for the same current.

formula_ipc2221_legacy._comment: I = k * dT^0.44 * A^0.725 ; A = cross-section in mil^2, dT = rise in degC. Solve for A then width = A / thickness.

formula_ipc2152_area_mil2._comment: A[mil^2] = (117.555*dT^-0.913 + 1.15) * I^(0.84*dT^-0.108 + 1.159). Validated within 3% of IPC-2152 chart at I=10A,dT=20C. width = A / thickness_mil.

courtyard_density_levels._comment: IPC-7351B. courtyard_excess_mm is added around a footprint's max physical/land extent to form the keep-out used by place_refine de-collision. Default level B. Values are general headline numbers; the standard tabulates excess per component family (chip/SOIC/QFP/BGA) for exact work.
courtyard_density_levels._uncertain: sources split: Nominal 0.20 vs 0.25, Most 0.40 vs 0.50. Using the larger (more conservative) of each.

controlled_impedance._comment: IPC-2141A / IPC-2221 targets. Geometry (width/gap for these Z) lives in net_classes.json + stackup_profiles.json; this is the standard-side index. ohms.
controlled_impedance._note: 50 ohm single-ended is impractical on 2-layer 1.6 mm (needs ~3 mm trace) -> controlled impedance requires 4-layer. See stackup_profiles.json auto_select.

via_protection_ipc4761._comment: IPC-4761 via protection types (3-0 verified against the primary standard PDF). Reference only; modelled when via-in-pad (Type VII) is needed under fine-pitch BGA.
via_protection_ipc4761.I: Tented — dry-film mask bridged over via, hole empty (I-a one side, I-b both)
via_protection_ipc4761.V: Filled — hole fully filled, no cap
via_protection_ipc4761.VII: Filled and capped — plated over; basis for via-in-pad

copper_weights_um._comment: Finished copper thickness by weight (1 oz = 35 um verified primary). ampacity scales as area^0.725, so heavier copper carries more current at the same width but coarsens min trace/space.
